L132: ${F}_{\mathrm{\ell }}(\eta ,\rho )$ is a real and analytic function of $\rho $ on the open interval $0<\rho <\mathrm{\infty }$, and also an analytic function of $\eta $ when $-\mathrm{\infty }<\eta <\mathrm{\infty }$.
L133: The normalizing constant ${C}_{\mathrm{\ell }}\left(\eta \right)$ is always positive, and has the alternative form
L134: 
L135: 33.2.6  |  | $${C}_{\mathrm{\ell }}\left(\eta \right)=\frac{{2}^{\mathrm{\ell }}{\left((2\pi \eta /({\mathrm{e}}^{2\pi \eta }-1)){\prod }_{k=1}^{\mathrm{\ell }}({\eta }^{2}+{k}^{2})\right)}^{1/2}}{(2\mathrm{\ell }+1)!}.$$  |
